# Native persistent-block boundary edits

Recorded with the reference application on September 25, 2026. Source is the independently
authored `../control.docx`, generated by `tools/persistent_block_control_fixture.py`.
No app export was used to create these references.

Reproduce with `tools/record_persistent_block_boundary_matrix.ps1`, then
`python tools/persistent_block_boundary_reference.py`. The former creates its
own reference-application instance and closes it without saving changes to the source. Its
SaveAs2 destination is explicitly cast to a string: passing the PowerShell
Join-Path expression directly stalled at SaveAs2 on this machine. Step logs
distinguish a completed mutation from a stalled save.

Seven operations are repeated for one- and two-paragraph persistent rich-text
controls and a showing-placeholder control. `reference.json` includes selected visible text, replacement, complete
before/after text, resulting control text/kind, paragraph structure, and hashes.
The reference application character offsets include invisible control boundaries; the selected text
is the useful mapping to the editor's visible-text coordinates.

Single-paragraph controls become inline controls after joining either edge.
Replacement from outside the start stays outside the control; replacement
through the end stays inside it. Inserting a paragraph break before the remaining
contents leaves those contents in an inline control in the last new paragraph.

Two-paragraph controls retain their block wrapper and surrounding paragraph
boundaries. Deleting just an outer boundary has no textual effect. Cross-boundary
replacements edit the selected letters but retain a paragraph boundary. With
`X\rY` across the start, the reference application puts X at the end of the preceding paragraph and Y
in a separate paragraph before the control. Inspect `bodyParagraphs` for the
complete structure; neither absorbing outside text nor unconditional conversion
to inline reproduces these results.

The extended cases also show that a paragraph break inserted across the end of
a single-paragraph control puts subsequent inserted text outside the inline
wrapper. For a multi-paragraph control the inserted paragraphs remain inside.
Partial cross-boundary replacement of a placeholder is rejected by the reference application.
Deleting all contents across the start leaves an empty inline wrapper, even for
the two-paragraph source. Empty persistent rich-text wrappers are now retained
as zero-length objects in the editor; no visible character is inserted.

`converted-placeholder-restored.docx` opens the saved placeholder-join-start
result, enters text, then clears its contents. The reference application restores five spaces, not
the displayed Alpha beta text. This has its own hash in `reference.json`.

Tests check native-result import/preservation, supported mutations through
export/reopen/undo, follow-up placeholder edits, and atomic rejection for
protected partial prompts. The empty-wrapper imports, boundary mutations and
follow-up entry/clear are covered too. Nested wrappers,
scoped bookmarks/fields, plain-text wrappers and joins across deeper internal
paragraphs remain guarded pending ownership support. These references do not
establish template completion.
